source.title: Smokey & Meerky - Wasteland Apothecary
source.name: Smokey & Meerky
source.description: A Support who can heal and imbue buffs to nearby allies continuously.

skills.name: Special Aroma

description.raw: After the battle starts, Smokey & Meerky immediately create a special aroma within 2 tiles, continuously emitting its effects while channeling. While the aroma is present, Smokey & Meerky recover 50 Energy per second, and all allies inside the area of effect regain 21% (ATK-based) per second. Passive: Smokey & Meerky cannot maintain the aroma if they are under Control Effects and cannot recreate it for 4 seconds once it is interrupted. Active: Smokey & Meerky heal all allies within the aroma by 170% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based), and the aroma permanently enhances as follows: - Improved Aroma I: Expands the area of effect by 1 tile. - Improved Aroma II: Grants 30 haste to all allies within the aroma.

skills.name: Energizing Formula

description.raw: Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of all allies within the aroma by 16% + 1% (SP-based). Additionally, for each non-summoned ally affected, they recover 5 Energy per second.
active: Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of all allies within the aroma by 16% + 1% (SP-based).

text: Recover 8 additional Energy per second for every non-summoned ally affected.

skills.description_lite: Smokey & Meerky increase the ATK of allies within the aroma and recover Energy.

skills.name: Quick Recovery

description.raw: Smokey & Meerky instantly heal all allies within the aroma by 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based).

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK by 6% during battle. If 3 or more non-summoned allies other than Smokey & Meerky are within the aroma, they increase their ATK by an additional 9%.
active: Smokey & Meerky passively increase their ATK by 6%.
If there are at least 3 non-summoned allies inside the aroma, their ATK is further increased by 9%.

skills.description_lite: Smokey & Meerky increase their ATK, and the ATK bonus is further increased when there are 3 or more non-summoned allies within the aroma.

skills.name: Withering Potion

description.raw: The Special Aroma gains a third upgrade, increasing its area of effect by 1 tile. Additionally, when the skill reaches its third enhancement for the first time, the aroma is empowered for 10 seconds, causing all enemies within range to lose 12% of their max HP per second. However, the HP lost cannot exceed 200% of Smokey & Meerky’s ATK.
